reuse.why: Selects categories through the existing getMonthWideBudgetCategories, reads spending with getSheetValue/sum-amount like setNMonthAvg, writes via setBudget inside batchMessages, and registers with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

duplication.why: Repeats the loop skeleton with the `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` guard that every month-wide action in this tree carries; there is no shared iteration helper to call, so this follows the existing pattern rather than adding new logic.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and is exposed in budget/app.ts next to them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its siblings; the income-category rule is still repeated per action, which a maintainer has to keep in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthWideBudgetCategories for the category selection like the other month-wide actions.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income guard and loop are plain copies of the existing pattern, not reshaped.
